title: Hitler's World War I poems to Odin and Thor
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Hitler's World War I poems to Odin and Thor, about 1914-1918 at Germany / Western Front, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> and wasn't Hitler writing poetry to the Nordic gods and as a soldier in World War I? >> Yes, he was. He wrote it. They're reprinted in I think it's Tolen's biography of Hitler.

plain: An author named Peter Levenda agrees with podcast host Jesse Michels that Adolf Hitler, while a soldier in the First World War, wrote poems to the old Norse gods such as Odin and Thor. Levenda says the poems are reprinted in a biography of Hitler, which he believes is the one by the historian John Toland. He tells it to show that Hitler was drawn to pagan, mystical ideas from early on.
